revision: BodyV6 ECO r4 - populated fit model

inputs.component_models: 3d/*-populated-native.step (KiCad 10.0.4 native export of models/ -- registered vendor CAD or labelled envelopes, see models/manifest.json); C52/C53 DNP have no model
inputs.board_bodies: 1.0 mm nominal prisms rebuilt from Edge.Cuts with NPTH holes (KiCad exports only the 0.929 mm dielectric stack)

frame: BodyV6.step coordinates: X = u - 28, Z = 47.5 - v (u,v = KiCad board mm), Y = board normal, F (battery/back) side toward -Y

board_pose.main: B face on the case pillar seats at Y = 9.275, F face Y = 8.275
board_pose.encoder: B face on the case post shoulders at Y = 3.5 (spigots dia 2.4 reach Y 2.5), F face Y = 2.5, facing the back cover; the cover boss tops are at Y = 2.3 so the board can float 0.2 mm toward the cover (screw clamp tolerance)

case_solid_naming: Fusion export is one part with 9 solids; names here are interpretations by bounding box (Case, Wheel, 4 side buttons, 2 front buttons, BackCover)

intersections.interpretation: USB-C shell vs the case opening corners (u 23.45-32.55, v 0.27-1.0): same 0.16 mm3 as r3/BodyV5 (undimensioned rounded mouth corners); unchanged
wheel shaft inside the encoder hollow-shaft bore (u 46.5-48.5, v 7.4-9.6): the intended press-fit; same 0.62 mm3 as r3

NEW in BodyV6: the encoder body (2.86 mm below the encoder-board F face at Y 2.5) passes through the full 1.0 mm back-cover plate over u 44.6-50.4 / v 6.15-12.0 and protrudes 0.35 mm beyond the outer cover face (Y -0.345). BodyV5 had no back cover in the fit model, so this was never checked. Needs a ~6 x 6 mm cover opening (or pocket) at the encoder, a different board level, or a lower-profile encoder.

findings: ENC1 vs BackCover: 15.94 mm3 interference (see intersections). This is the one new BodyV6 conflict.

Encoder board vs Wheel: 0 mm. The wheel hub underside (r <= ~3 mm) lies at Y = 3.5, coincident with the encoder board B face around the 3.0 x 4.59 mm aperture; the wheel would rub on the board unless the board sits 0.2 mm lower (on the cover bosses) or the hub is relieved.

C11 (44.5,68.5) and R7 (47.1,67.5), B side: 0.041 / 0.025 mm to the case post that seats on the B face around (45.4-47.5, 68.0-69.5). Inherited from r3 (same post in BodyV5); nominal envelopes only, so real parts may touch. Consider 0.2 mm moves or a post relief.
R39 0.325 mm and Y1 0.611 mm from the new bottom-right pillar/block (placed in this ECO); main board edge 0.32 mm from the wheel rim at (42.2,15.6); 0.24-0.30 mm from the side-button bodies.
Side switches SW1/SW2/SW5/SW6: 0.06 mm to the side-button bodies (actuator preload gap, as in BodyV5). SW3/SW4 0.89 mm to the front-button caps (travel gap).
J5 USB-C 0.16 mm3 in the case mouth corners: unchanged from r3.
Encoder J1 underside 0.415 mm above the cover plate; laterally clear of the MH2 boss.
limitations: Static nominal assembly; no button travel, no display module, no battery, no cable, no fasteners.
Component geometry is the release model set (vendor CAD where registered, otherwise labelled envelopes).
Boolean interference threshold 1e-4 mm3; clearances reported only below 1.5 mm; distances to the Case solid computed for every item.

outputs.3d/main-populated-bodyv6.step: main board + 120 fitted components in the BodyV6 frame
outputs.3d/encoder-populated-bodyv6.step: encoder board + ENC1 + J1 in the BodyV6 frame
outputs.3d/bodyv6-fit-assembly.step: BodyV6 case solids + both populated boards
